## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts
- CKNE-to-resource mapping: concurrency, queue depth, backoff
- Minute-by-minute rebalancing and SLA preservation

## Code Example
```javascript
function mapCKNEToResources(ckne){
  // simple linear mapping for beginner-friendly task queue
  const maxCon = 1 + Math.round(ckne * 4); // 1-5
  const depth = Math.round(5 + ckne * 15); // 5-20
  const backoff = 1000 * (1 + (1-ckne) * 4); // 1s-5s
  return {maxCon, depth, backoff};
```
